INSERT INTO bibliography_entries (entry_key, entry_type, title, authors, year, journal, volume, number, pages, doi, url, abstract, keywords, relevance_score, created_at, updated_at) VALUES 
('russo2011taming', 'article', 'Taming THC: potential cannabis synergy and phytocannabinoid-terpenoid entourage effects', 'Russo, Ethan B.', 2011, 'British Journal of Pharmacology', '163', '7', '1344-1364', '10.1111/j.1476-5381.2011.01238.x', 'https://bpspubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1111/j.1476-5381.2011.01238.x', 'This comprehensive review explores the synergistic interactions between phytocannabinoids and terpenoids, establishing the theoretical framework for the entourage effect in cannabis.', 'terpenes,cannabinoids,synergy,entourage effect,phytochemistry', 95, NOW(), NOW()),

('ferber2020entourage', 'article', 'The entourage effect: terpenes coupled with cannabinoids for the treatment of mood disorders and anxiety disorders', 'Ferber, Sari G.; Namdar, Dvora; Hen-Shoval, Danielle; et al.', 2020, 'Current Neuropharmacology', '18', '2', '87-96', '10.2174/1570159X17666190903103923', 'https://www.ingentaconnect.com/content/ben/cn/2020/00000018/00000002/art00004', 'Review of the entourage effect focusing on therapeutic applications of terpene-cannabinoid combinations for mood and anxiety disorders.', 'entourage effect,terpenes,cannabinoids,anxiety,mood disorders', 90, NOW(), NOW()),

('masyita2022terpenes', 'article', 'Terpenes and terpenoids as main bioactive compounds of essential oils', 'Masyita, Asma; et al.', 2022, 'Heliyon', '8', '5', 'e09407', '10.1016/j.heliyon.2022.e09407', 'https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9039924/', 'Comprehensive review of terpenes and terpenoids as bioactive compounds in essential oils, covering their biological activities and applications.', 'terpenes,terpenoids,essential oils,bioactive compounds,aromatherapy', 88, NOW(), NOW()),

('koyama2020effects', 'article', 'The Effects of Essential Oils and Terpenes in Relation to Their Routes of Intake and Application', 'Koyama, Sachiko; Heinbockel, Thomas', 2020, 'International Journal of Molecular Sciences', '21', '5', '1558', '10.3390/ijms21051558', 'https://www.mdpi.com/1422-0067/21/5/1558', 'Summary of the three systems involved in essential oil effects and their constituents at cellular and systems level.', 'essential oils,terpenes,olfaction,pharmacology,routes of administration', 85, NOW(), NOW()),

('siddiqui2024terpenoids', 'article', 'Terpenoids in essential oils: Chemistry, classification, and potential applications', 'Siddiqui, Tabassum; et al.', 2024, 'Phytomedicine Plus', '4', '1', '100277', '10.1016/j.phyplu.2024.100277', 'https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2667031324000277', 'Review of terpenoid chemistry, classification and their antimicrobial and antioxidant activities in plant disease resistance.', 'terpenoids,essential oils,antimicrobial,antioxidant,chemistry', 82, NOW(), NOW());
